why_ai: Converged billing-report software that hyperscaler tools and AI agents can replicate from the same export.
why_clarity: Savings show on the next monthly bill, though methods for driving engineering action vary.
why_digital: Billing exports are ingested and analysed as cloud software sold remotely.

why_ai: Platforms ingest identical billing data and render identical charts, so differentiation erodes easily.
why_clarity: Spend visibility and allocation are defined outputs checked against the monthly invoice.
why_digital: A SaaS dashboard over cloud billing data, bought and used entirely online.

why_ai: Portfolio optimisation under uncertainty is a well-posed problem software solves better than analysts.
why_clarity: Savings rate is exact, but whether a three-year commitment was right is known years later.
why_digital: Usage forecasts and reserved instance purchases happen entirely through cloud consoles and APIs.

why_ai: Ownership is inferable from deployment and code evidence that ML can mine directly.
why_clarity: Every cost should map to an owner, but correct ownership is often disputed between teams.
why_digital: Resource metadata, tags and repositories are joined entirely as data.

why_ai: A proprietary multi-customer spend corpus is durable, though the analysis on it automates.
why_clarity: What a workload should cost is defined by peers, but comparability judgments vary.
why_digital: Structured billing data already ingested is aggregated into benchmark products.

why_ai: Rightsizing is technically automatable; only engineer trust and safety context slow it down.
why_clarity: A recommendation is right if it saves money without an incident, visible within weeks.
why_digital: Utilisation metrics in, code or config changes out, all on screen.

why_ai: Allocation, reconciliation and variance explanation are rule-driven finance tasks AI handles well.
why_clarity: Allocations must reconcile exactly to the invoice and survive audit every month.
why_digital: Invoices, cost centres and forecasts are spreadsheet and ledger work on screen.

why_ai: Joining colocation contracts, licences and depreciated hardware needs messy cross-system judgment AI only partly covers.
why_clarity: Total workload cost is definable, but each enterprise estate is configured differently.
why_digital: Inputs include contracts and owned hardware records, but the costing work is on screen.

why_ai: The scheduler and runtime hold all the data needed, so allocation is computable by software.
why_clarity: Container cost allocation follows codifiable rules applied to thousands of identical workloads.
why_digital: Cluster telemetry and billing data are processed entirely in software.

why_ai: The cost of a change is computable before merge, so cost feedback becomes automatic tooling.
why_clarity: Cost impact per change is calculable, but what is safe to cut takes engineering judgment.
why_digital: Engineers work in code, pull requests and dashboards entirely on screen.

why_ai: Chasing tags and variance archaeology automate, leaving a thinner persuasion role between finance and engineering.
why_clarity: Variance explanations and tagging targets exist, but success relies on persuasion with fuzzy outcomes.
why_digital: Spreadsheets, billing data and messages, with the role embedded inside the organisation.
